# Mir Yoke — AI routing index

## Start here
- `README.md` — supported surfaces and the short new-project prompt
- `BOOTSTRAP.md` — choose Minimal Starter, standard Project Agent Kit, or optional installed CLI
- `recipes/project-agent-kit/README.md` — standard empty-target Project Agent Kit procedure
- `recipes/project-agent-kit/reviewer.md` — repository-unique review skill and agent contract
- `recipes/project-agent-kit/verification.md` — real checks, Git hook, and initial-commit gates

## Minimal consumer payload
- `starter/README.md`
- `starter/HARNESS.md`
- `starter/CLAUDE.md`
- `starter/AGENTS.md`

## Authority
- `docs/decisions/adr-83-project-agent-kit-recipe-and-supported-surfaces.md`
- `docs/decisions/adr-81-minimal-starter-support-boundary.md`
- `docs/decisions/adr-74-portable-bootstrap-capability-sources-and-memory.md`
- `docs/decisions/INDEX.md`

## Optional automation and references
- `mir --help` — installed v0.8-compatible operator commands; explicit invocation required
- `reference-templates/advanced-composition/` — inert ADR-82 files; no active `yoke` command

## Maintainer checks
- `uv run pytest -q tests/test_project_agent_kit.py tests/test_minimal_starter.py`
- `uv run python scripts/verify_codex_sync.py`
- `uv run ruff check`

The Starter is the only fixed payload. The Project Agent Kit creates project-owned files under the
target agent's explicit authority. The installed CLI is optional and acts only when separately
invoked for a named scope; path presence alone authorizes nothing.
